_note: Clinic directory for the referral screen. Edit this file to correct or add entries — no Dart changes needed. 'x' and 'y' are normalised positions (0..1) on assets/map/tacloban.png, read off the marker positions on that map; a clinic with no x/y still appears in the list, just without a pin. Navigation never uses them — the Directions button searches the map app by name and address, so an imprecise pin can never route anyone to the wrong building.
